risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~111% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.423), which favours a weighted combination.

Test the best single model hypothesis by evaluating ONLY_DWT_rf alone.
Test a weighted combination using inverse error weighting on the full model pool to see if it improves over the best single.
Test a weighted combination on a different pool (pool3) using inverse_error weights to see if it improves on the best single.
Test a weighted combination using pool2 with inverse_error weights to see if a different subset improves over current leader.
Test a weighted combination on pool1 using inverse_error weights to see if a smaller, more correlated pool improves over the best single.
Test a deterministic baseline with a different pool – median over pool1 to see if a smaller pool improves over weighted.
Test a deterministic median over pool2 to see if a slightly larger pool improves over median pool1.
Test a weighted combination on the larger pool4 to see if more models help, using inverse_error weights.
Test a deterministic median over pool4 to see if a larger pool improves over previous medians.
Test a simple mean over pool4 to see if averaging the 8 models improves over the weighted and median results.
Evaluate a trimmed mean over pool4 to see if trimming improves over the plain mean and weighted results.
Test a data‑driven Bayesian aggregation on the full pool4 to see if it can beat the best single model.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single ONLY_DWT_rf' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.3649. Series context: trend strength 0.9729 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.423); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 25.752.
